en: Black‑and‑white postcard with two photographs of the same rural courtyard from different angles. The upper image shows a large half‑timbered farmhouse with a steep, tiled gabled roof, dormer windows, and a ground floor of plastered masonry. The courtyard in front is unpaved and contains a stone trough or fountain and some farm equipment. The lower image is taken from within the same yard, showing another plain rendered building with a similar steep roof, a barn-like structure to the left, trees and a wooden gate opening toward the surrounding countryside. The card edges are scalloped, suggesting a mid‑20th‑century photographic postcard.
